---
title: "How does the zoom height vary with launch speed, and what launch speed would double it?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
import numpy as np

v_baseline = V_LAUNCH
zoom_baseline = launch_height(v_baseline) - H_RELEASE

v_target = v_baseline * np.sqrt(2)
zoom_target = launch_height(v_target) - H_RELEASE
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{v_target:.1f}"`]{.hero-value}
[m/s to double the zoom height]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Zoom height varies with the square of the launch speed. To double the baseline zoom of [`{python} f"{zoom_baseline:.2f}"`]{.key} m to [`{python} f"{zoom_target:.2f}"`]{.key} m, the baseline [`{python} f"{v_baseline:.0f}"`]{.key} m/s launch speed must increase by a factor of $\sqrt{2}$.
